explanation: Generated an EXCLURAD input for the eta point W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0, phi*=90 deg, using default eta-channel settings (model=3 maid2000/EtaMAID, rc_mode=0 full O(alpha), bmom=6.53 GeV, tmom=0.0, lepton=1 electron, ivec=1 proton) and vcut set to -0.1 as requested. This is a documentation/code mismatch, not a crash risk, but the user should be aware the requested -0.1 cut will not actually restrict the radiated-photon phase space. The file was generated as requested since -0.1 is a syntactically valid input value; if the user intended an actual v-cut of 0.1 GeV^2, they should use vcut=0.1 (positive) instead.
